title: The newsroom has its brief; three decisions at 13:00 unblock Indi and Vicky
headline: Since brief 13, 37 agent commits. Your vision memo is now the newsroom's brief pack, live at web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai/brief/ (ten pages, your words first). Indi asked again for push access to the newsroom, and her designer agent put RiskMandate business cards on /cards/. Vicky's agents moved to one report a day and published a plain-language onboarding guide (WS-100). Vicky's logistics agent warns the printer may slip to Monday 9 November. Your 13:00 briefing PDF is sent.
